android.releaseNotes:
• Reliable E2E Voice Notes: Automated on-demand download, decryption, and playback for encrypted voice messages with duration synchronization and audio error recovery.
• Fluid Liquid Glass Navigation: Interactive fluid magnification expanding the indicator when dragged, natural compact pill sizing, and gesture cancel protection.
• Streamlined In-Call Control Bar: Ergonomic two-tier in-call layout separating secondary utilities (minimize, screen share, invite) from primary call actions (mute, video, audio routing, end call).
• Chat & UI Enhancements: Adaptive message bubble corner curvatures for sender grouping, jitter-free typing input bar, and new message FAB.
